name: pythonscad
description: Compile and syntax-check .scad and PythonSCAD .py files using the PythonSCAD engine directly, with inline diagnostics and model export.

commands.title: PythonSCAD: Trust This Workspace to Run Python Files

pythonscad.executablePath.description: Path to the PythonSCAD executable (or app bundle on macOS). Leave empty to auto-detect.

pythonscad.checkOnSave.description: Run a compile/syntax check whenever a .scad or PythonSCAD .py file is saved.

pythonscad.checkOnType.description: Run a compile/syntax check while typing, debounced by pythonscad.checkOnTypeDelay.

pythonscad.checkOnTypeDelay.description: Milliseconds to debounce checks when pythonscad.checkOnType is enabled.

pythonscad.checkExportFormat.description: Lightweight export format used to drive the compile check (does not write a kept file).

enumDescriptions: Only pass --trust-python (execute .py files) when the VS Code workspace is trusted.
Always pass --trust-python. Only use this for workspaces you fully trust.
Never execute PythonSCAD .py files; only .scad files are checked.
pythonscad.trustPythonExecution.description: Controls whether PythonSCAD is allowed to execute Python (.py) files, which run arbitrary code.

pythonscad.pythonFileHeuristic.description: Only treat .py files as PythonSCAD files when they import the 'openscad' module. Disable to check every open .py file.

pythonscad.extraArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to PythonSCAD for every check.
